about_short_description.short_description: Bracket bring together best-in-class science, technology & service to drive superior clinical outcome results for pharmaceutical companies.

identifier.value: Signant SmartSignals Clinical Trial Solution Suite

product.name: Signant SmartSignals Clinical Trial Solution Suite
product.description: A comprehensive technology platform for clinical trial evidence generation and study management, supporting data capture, patient and site participation, supply chain management, and in-study analytics.

product.name: Clinical Rater Training & Qualification Solutions
product.description: Training programs aimed at standardizing clinician assessments to reduce variability and improve data quality in clinical trial endpoints.

product.name: Computerized Adaptive Testing (PROMIS CAT)
product.description: A solution using item response theory to tailor patient questionnaires dynamically for assessing various health domains within clinical trials.

product.name: Integration Solutions (Marketplace)
product.description: A set of APIs and technical resources enabling integration of Signant’s clinical trial technology products with other eClinical systems.
